title: Projected Need for Informal Caregivers in Next 10 to 20 Years
what_it_is: Projected Need for Informal Caregivers in Next 10 to 20 Years

sections.label: Support for caregivers and seniors
sections.summary: The Government has strengthened caregiver support and scaled up aged care services, and is reviewing the aged care landscape.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Twelve thousand four hundred of these caregivers were looking after their aged, ill or disabled parents.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: As our population ages, more seniors will need care and there will be more caregivers who may need support.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: To prepare for this, we have strengthened support for caregivers, such as through the recent enhancement to the Home Caregiving Grant.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The Government has also scaled up the capacity for aged care services, such as home and day care services, over the years to meet the needs of seniors.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: We are reviewing the aged care landscape to better anchor care in the community and support seniors to age well at home.

sections.label: Community care manpower schemes
sections.summary: MOH and AIC have helped community care organisations attract and retain manpower through recruitment, branding and salary schemes.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Health (MOH) and the Agency for Integrated Care (AIC) have helped community care organisations attract and retain manpower through schemes to support local recruitment, branding of the sector and salary enhancements.

sections.label: Considerations in supporting caregiving services
sections.summary: The Ministry sees the family as the first line of defence and has concerns about fiscal sustainability.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: However, when we talk about supporting, from the Ministry's perspective as to how we support the caregiving services, there are some considerations that we have to take into account.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: We see the family as the first line of defence and we need to ensure that we are advocating for the right behaviours and there are also concerns about the fiscal sustainability of the approaches that we take in this.

sections.label: Exploring models under ageing action plan
sections.summary: Under the refreshed action plan for successful ageing, different models are already being explored.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: On the question in respect of the different models, under the refreshed action plan for successful ageing, we are already exploring with different models.
